changeSet.sql: WITH ranked_running AS ( SELECT id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY created_at, id) AS queue_position FROM agent_run WHERE status = 'RUNNING' ) UPDATE agent_run SET status = 'QUEUED', execution_owner = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, heartbeat_at = NULL WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM ranked_running WHERE queue_position > 1)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uk_agent_run_active_user ON agent_run (user_id) WHERE status = 'RUNNING'

rollback.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uk_agent_run_active_conversation ON agent_run (conversation_id) WHERE status = 'RUNNING'
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uk_agent_run_queued_conversation ON agent_run (conversation_id) WHERE status = 'QUEUED'
